column2:
Market approach: The
valuation model uses
prices and other relevant
information generated
by market transactions
involving identical or
similar assets. The fair
value is determined as
the price that would be
paid to sell the land and
buildings in an orderly
transaction to market
participants
column4:
The estimated fair values
would increase /
(decrease):-
1. If property prices
near the location of
the property were
higher / (lower);
2. With improvements /
(deterioration) in
infrastructure
development.
